title: Automated fluorescence image stitching for high-throughput and digital microfluidic biosensors

Fluorescence imaging underpins digital PCR (dPCR), microarrays, and microfluidic biosensors, yet precise image integration remains a technical bottleneck when the sample area exceeds the microscope field of view.
